Settings.Name: Import PDF
Settings.Label: Import
Settings.Hint: Import the documents from the modern Chaosium PDF layout.

Form.MapsHint: Each map image in the folder becomes a Scene, in Scene folders mirroring its subfolders; each chapter's English handouts become a Journal Entry; creature and character tokens become the art of the imported actors they name (import the books first); its other PDFs (props, player aids) become pages of a Documents journal. A map pack's user manual in the folder supplies each map's grid size.

Errors.NoFiles: Choose at least one file or a folder of maps
